description: Tab container built on native details/summary with keyboard navigation and view transitions

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Names the set of tabs. When the host has aria-label or aria-labelledby (and no role of its own) it gets role="group" on upgrade, so the name is exposed; an unlabelled tab-set stays role-less. Read at upgrade.

attributes.name: data-orientation
attributes.description: Vertical puts the tabs in a column at the inline start with the panel beside them, and adds ArrowUp/ArrowDown navigation. Horizontal tabs wrap onto further rows when they don't fit.

attributes.name: transition
attributes.description: View Transition animation between tab panels

structure.description: One per tab — native disclosure element provides open/close state. Give every tab the same name for no-JS exclusivity; on upgrade a missing, mixed or page-shared name is replaced with a per-instance one
Exactly one panel element per <details>, after the summary. Use <section>: it is named by its tab (aria-labelledby) and exposed as a region; a <div> panel's name is ignored

events.name: tab-set:change
events.description: Fired once per activation (click, arrow key or setting details.open), from the newly opened tab. index is the new tab, previousIndex the one it replaced, tab its <details>, panel its panel element. Not fired during setup or when the active tab is re-selected

events.name: tab-set:tabs-changed
events.description: Fired after the tabs property rebuilds the set

properties.name: tabs
properties.description: Get the tabs as data, or assign an array to rebuild the set (<details> + <summary> + <section> panel per entry; first tab opens unless one has active: true). content is trusted HTML written with innerHTML — never pass unsanitised user input
